heatDefinition: 1-month total-return proxy in USD: the unweighted mean of the available legs — sovereign bond price proxy converted to USD, country equity ETF return, regional EM corporate credit carry, the fallen-angel ETF proxy, and, for markets with no free sovereign curve, the currency return against the dollar. Green means positive compensation over the last month, red negative.

US.name: United States
US.heatBasis: unweighted mean of 3 live 1-month USD return proxies: bond, equity, fallen_angel

bonds.notes: 10Y benchmark government bond yield — US 10Y Treasury (FRED DGS10 history + same-day US Treasury par-yield curve, month-collapsed)
bonds.usd_note: no currency leg — the local price proxy is used as-is

fx.note: United States — the US dollar is the base currency

equity_etf.label: SPY

sovereign_spread.note: 10Y yield minus the US 10Y — a sovereign risk proxy, not a traded CDS quote (no free CDS source exists)

structural.note: World Bank annual indicators — structural context, lagged by 1-2 years. Never used in heat.
